lines.en: - Yeah, well, we called everyone in your phone book,
and a bunch of people came,
but it took us so long to get you here
- We wanted to throw you a big surprise
and now you don't have either.
- Well, no, wait a minute. That's not true.
No, what you did, it was really sweet.
And it kind of works out for the best.
- Well, now I get to spend my shower
with the only people I really love.
I mean, and I get all those presents
without having to talk to a bunch of people
